en.description:
One tap. Two heroes. How long can you keep them in sync?

Pulse Duo is a neon arcade game of reflexes, rhythm and precise timing. Hold to bring your heroes together and release to spread them apart. Find the gap, dodge obstacles and turn a close call into a Perfect pass.

FIND YOUR RHYTHM
Build your high score in Classic, take on a daily challenge or explore a campaign with changing zones and boss encounters. Turbo starts fast and doubles track coins and crystals; it unlocks at 1,000 points. Split Rhythm unlocks at 2,000 points and gives each hero separate touch controls. Play both sides yourself or share one device with a friend.

FACE THE NEXT CHALLENGE
Read lasers, springs, fog and changing patterns. Chain Perfect passes, complete daily and weekly tasks, and face consecutive boss phases in Boss Rush after unlocking it through the campaign. Gold Rush is a coin-collecting mode available during scheduled events.

MAKE THE DUO YOURS
Collect skins, effects and threads. Personalize your profile with frames and titles, and discover rewards through play, chests and seasonal activities. Cosmetic items change appearance only. Random reward odds are shown before opening or spinning.

CHASE YOUR NEXT RECORD
Compare all-time, daily and monthly scores, and save supported progress to the cloud with a connected game profile. Core arcade modes work offline; rankings, cloud saves and some timed features require a connection.

Game interface: English, Ukrainian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish and French. Adjust music, haptics and reduced-motion settings.

Free to play with optional in-app purchases, automatic ads and optional rewarded ads. Remove Automatic Ads removes automatic interstitials; rewarded ads remain optional. Mode unlocks, event schedules and reward conditions are shown in the game.
en.releaseNotes:
New in 1.4.6:
• 11 new Game Center achievements, from Coral Beacon to Neon Legend.
• Modes you can play now are listed first; locked and upcoming ones move to the bottom.
• Pop-up windows now dim the whole screen, edge to edge.
• Links from App Store events open the season, events, modes and shop directly.

versionHistory.releaseNotes: Updated the App Store listing to support advertising verification.

Optimized for the inner and outer displays of iPhone Duo. Watch a video to freeze one missed day of your daily streak. Try Split Rhythm Turbo, more campaign obstacles, new reward celebrations, and Game Center achievements.
New skin animations, thread effects, and auras for epic and legendary cosmetics. Boss fights are more challenging, and you can reduce motion in settings. Redeem new promo codes in About.

New in 1.4.4:
• Account levels: earn XP in every run, level up and claim rewards on the new reward road.
• Redesigned profile with your level, frame, title and stats.
• Exclusive Rhythm Veteran and Pulse Legend frames and titles at account levels 10, 20 and 30.
• Copper Tide: a new exclusive skin on the free season track.
• Brighter store and collection: rarer items look and shine more premium.
• Daily offers and video rewards refresh every day; completed items disappear.
• Performance improvements and fixes.

New in 1.4.5:
• Smoother play: no more stutter when opening levels or switching tabs.
• Comeback track: after a break, five days of gifts with a chest on the last day.
• Balanced audio in every mode, level and boss fight.
• Notifications arrive at friendlier times.
• The Style tab opens on your selected skin, effect or string.
• New micro-animations and better performance across iPhone models, including iPhone Duo and Apple Watch.

• 11 new Game Center achievements, from Coral Beacon to Neon Legend.

• Pop-up windows now dim the whole screen, edge to edge.
